title: Calculations, Percentages and Rates
summary: Percentage increase and decrease, reverse percentages, percentage points, compound percentage changes, rates and unit pricing, and estimation and checking.

notes.title: Worked example 1
notes.problem: Matric pass rates at a school rose from 72% to 81%. By how many percentage points did they rise, and what is the percentage increase?

notes.label: Percentage points
notes.text: A change from 72% to 81% is **9 percentage points**, but it is a **12,5% increase** on the original. Newspapers often confuse the two.

notes.title: Worked example 2
notes.problem: After a 20% discount a TV costs R5 600. What was the original price?
steps: R5 600 is 80% of the original price.

notes.title: Worked example 3

A shop offers 'Buy 3, pay for 2' on shampoo at R54,99 each, or a 30% discount on each bottle elsewhere. Which is better value for 3 bottles?
questions.memo:
✓ Buy 3 pay for 2: 2 × R54,99 = R109,98 (1)
✓ 30% off: 3 × R54,99 × 0,7 = R115,48 (1)
✓ The 'Buy 3, pay for 2' offer is better (1)
